candidates.change_summary: Change the final return statement from returning true to returning false.
Change the length guard to require(_tos.length > 1) so single-element batches revert.
Delete the require(_s) check so failing transferFrom calls no longer revert the transaction.
Start the loop at i=1 so the first recipient is skipped entirely.
Return false instead of true on successful completion.
Pass v+1 to transferFrom so the transferred amount differs and can revert where the original succeeded.
